audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 0, 2, 3 and 4 disagreed with the packet chart even though the whys printed beside them already say the opposite.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is [Yone, Yone, Skill, Yone, Yone, Yone, Yone]; whys[0] says level 1 favours you, whys[2] calls level 3 even skill, whys[3] says 4-5 swing back to you, whys[4] says level 6 stays yours.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 3 and 4 -> Yone, row 2 -> Skill, as matched full+content pairs, with row 0's rating raised to 6/10.

audit.why: The spike text already places his only real window at a landed E-into-Q and puts his ult in teamfights rather than the 1v1; the chart was the part out of step.

audit.whatIsWrong: The single most important interaction in this lane was missing: Elastic Slingshot grounds. Nothing on the page tells you that landing in it removes your Q3 dash and Fate Sealed. Two ability names were also wrong — 'Stretching Strike' and 'Let's Bounce' — and Cell Division's blob reabsorption was described only as 'blobs'.
audit.why: Zac's E carries the grounding flag (shuts off enemy dashes) and is 21/18/15/12/9s; his Q is 14/12.5/11/9.5/8s and resets his attack; his W is 5s of max-health damage; the real names are Stretching Strikes and Let's Bounce!.
audit.corrected: dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].d, dontsFull[0].d, dontsFull[1].d and breakdown.cooldowns rewritten around the grounding, the timers and the blob rule; the two names fixed in spikes[0], spikes[1] and mid.

edits.before: His engage. Dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: 21s at rank 1 — it grounds you, so your dashes are gone on impact.

edits.before: Zac wastes Elastic Slingshot — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: It needs charge time — step out of the landing circle, then commit.

edits.before: That is Zac's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Each ability he lands sheds a blob he can reabsorb — step on them first.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Grounded means no Q3 dash and no Fate Sealed — walk out first.

edits.before: - Zac Elastic Slingshot: matchup-defining — His engage. Dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Elastic Slingshot (E): 21s at rank 1, and it grounds — no dashes for you on impact. - Stretching Strikes (Q): 14s at rank 1, a grab that resets his auto. - Unstable Matter (W): 5s of max-health damage.

edits.before: You beat Zac in lane. His Stretching Strike (Q) is a slow, telegraphed grab and his Elastic Slingshot (E) needs charge time; dodge both and punish. Way of the Hunter poke plus your dashes let you trade every time his Q is on cooldown.
edits.after: You beat Zac in lane. Stretching Strikes (Q) is a 14s telegraphed grab and Elastic Slingshot (E) needs charge time and grounds you on landing; dodge both and punish. Way of the Hunter poke plus your dashes let you trade every time his Q is down.

edits.before: Let's Bounce (R) is a knockup teamfight tool, not a 1v1 threat. In lane it does little to stop you. Keep poking and shoving; his ult is for ganks and skirmishes, so ward and keep punishing his weak solo trades.
edits.after: Let's Bounce! (R) is a 120s knockup teamfight tool, not a 1v1 threat. In lane it does little to stop you. Keep poking and shoving; his ult is for ganks and skirmishes, so ward and punish his weak solo trades.

edits.before: Level 3 is skill: if he lands a clean E-slingshot into Q he can chunk you, so respect those cooldowns - but dodge them and levels 4-5 swing back hard your way as your trade pattern out-damages his. His level 6 Let's Bounce is a teamfight knockup, not a lane threat, so keep shoving and punishing his weak solo game.
edits.after: Level 3 is skill: a clean E-slingshot grounds you and chains into Q, so respect the 21s cooldown - dodge it and levels 4-5 swing back hard your way as your trade pattern out-damages his. His level 6 Let's Bounce! is a teamfight knockup, not a lane threat, so keep shoving and punishing his weak solo game.

notes: Restated from the mirror: Fate Sealed has no airborne requirement, so Yone's ult never needs a knockup set up for it — any page text implying a knockup chain between the two is wrong. Nothing on this page says it, so no correction was needed here.
